source.quote: 14,532,182,000 shares of common stock were issued and outstanding as of October 23, 2026.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as AAPL. The FY2026 10-K cover (filed November 3, 2026) is the latest count; the most recent 10-Q is for the quarter ended June 27, 2026, so it is older.
